title: golden-path-agent template parameters
description: Phase F2 (DECISIONS.md DEC-087 item 1; docs/phase-f-kickoff-plan.md SS6), amended at Phase G Stage 2 (DEC-098/DEC-099) when mcp_server/approval_service were removed from skeleton/ (the amended SysR-P-F-01 forbids this template from bundling either). The single source of truth for every value substituted into skeleton/ -- consumed identically by F3's CLI renderer and F5's RHDH Scaffolder Template (via the stock fetch:template action), so the two paths can never drift the way DEC-075's parallel-constant bug did. Every '${{ values.x }}' placeholder in skeleton/ corresponds to exactly one property below; there are no undocumented placeholders and no properties without a placeholder.

name.title: Project name
name.description: The base identifier for the scaffolded project. Every namespace, resource name, OIDC client ID, and OTEL service name in the rendered output is derived from this by fixed-suffix concatenation (e.g. '<name>-ci', '<name>-otel', '<name>-keycloak', '<name>-approval-workload') -- this is the ONLY identity parameter most of the skeleton actually needs. maxLength is set to keep every derived namespace name (the longest observed suffix is '-ephemeral-test', 15 chars) safely under Kubernetes' 63-char namespace-name limit, not because 40 chars is otherwise meaningful.

owner.title: Owning team
owner.description: Backstage catalog owner reference for the scaffolded project (e.g. 'group:default/team-name'). Documentation/attribution only -- never used in any infra manifest, only in developer-facing docs/README content.

description.title: Project description
description.description: One-sentence description of the scaffolded agent's purpose, used in README.md. Optional -- a generic placeholder sentence is used if omitted.
description.default: An agentic AI pilot agent scaffolded from the golden-path-agent blueprint.

mcpEndpoint.title: MCP tool server endpoint
mcpEndpoint.description: Base URL of the Tools Template instance this agent consumes (e.g. 'http://my-tools-mcp.my-tools-ns.svc.cluster.local:8081'). Phase G, Stage 2 (DEC-098/DEC-099): the agent no longer bundles or co-deploys an MCP server -- genuinely required, no default, since there is no same-project value to fall back to anymore (unlike repoOwner/repoName below, which are optional because nothing functional depends on them yet). The named consumer that mcpEndpoint's own Tools Template instance must admit (its own allowedConsumerName, template-schema-tools.json) should be this project's 'name' value.

mcpApiName.title: MCP tool server catalog API name
mcpApiName.description: The full name of the API entity the Tools Template instance mcpEndpoint points at registers itself as -- that template's own catalog-info.yaml names it '<name>-api' (its own 'name' scaffold parameter plus that fixed suffix), e.g. 'my-tools-api' for a Tools Template instance scaffolded with name 'my-tools'. Distinct from mcpEndpoint (a network address, not a catalog reference) -- this is what lets catalog-info.yaml's own consumesApis actually resolve to the right entity once both are live-registered in the same catalog. Optional: a placeholder is fine if the Tools Template instance isn't registered yet.

approvalServiceEndpoint.title: Platform approval service endpoint
approvalServiceEndpoint.description: Base URL of the shared Platform Foundation approval service (DEC-098's own architecture decision -- one singleton serves every agent project, not one per project). Genuinely required, no default, same reasoning as mcpEndpoint above; per the amended SysR-P-F-01, this project consumes the approval service through its published contract (SRS-APR-IF-01..05) and shall not bundle an approval-service implementation.

oidcIssuerUrl.title: Shared identity realm issuer URL
oidcIssuerUrl.description: Issuer URL of the shared Platform Foundation Keycloak realm this project's workload clients (approvalOidcClientId's own client, etc.) are registered against. Optional -- only load-bearing once AGENT_OIDC_MODE is switched from 'none' to 'oidc'; a placeholder default is safe until then.

modelRoute.title: Model route (informational, reserved)
modelRoute.description: Reserved for G5's catalog model completion -- once model routes are registered as catalog Resources (SysR-P-F-12's routing seam), this becomes a catalog-backed picker selecting one. Not yet wired to any rendered config value this phase (real model endpoint config is still supplied per-environment via deploy/kustomize/overlays/*, independent of scaffold-time templating); recorded on the rendered catalog-info.yaml as an annotation only, so the intent is visible even before the wiring exists.

repoOwner.title: Git repository owner/org
repoOwner.description: GitHub org or user that will own the scaffolded project's own repository. Only load-bearing for F5's explicit stretch goal (opening a PR against a real scratch repo, decision 4 / DEC-087) -- F2's own verification render and F3's local-only CLI path both work correctly with a placeholder value, since neither pushes anywhere. Known rough edge, not fully resolved this phase: a handful of doc-prose references (e.g. tools/trace-check's own README) still read a little awkwardly post-substitution since they were written assuming this repo IS the template, not a scaffolded instance of one -- cosmetic, not functional, and left for refinement whenever F5's stretch goal is actually attempted.

repoName.title: Git repository name
repoName.description: Name of the scaffolded project's own repository. Defaults to the same value as 'name' -- a real instance's repo is not itself a template, so it does not get a '-template' suffix the way this blueprint repo's own name has one. Only load-bearing for F5's publish stretch goal, same as repoOwner.
